title: Can we go to the park after we finish this?
scene: 他提议等下做某件事，并补充理由。

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Can we go to the park after we finish this?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Maybe we can, if it doesn't rain today.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I want to feed the ducks at the pond.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: But we don't have any bread for them.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Then we can stop for some bread first.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: That would be an extra stop for us, though.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Please, Dad? The brown duck always waits by the bench.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Okay, fine. We will get bread, and then we go to the park.

variations: "the park" 换 "the library"；"feed the ducks" 换 "read a book"。
